headline: World Bank Commends Rwanda's Renewable Energy Fund for Off-Grid Access
summary: Rwanda's Renewable Energy Fund Project was highlighted in a World Bank report for expanding access to off-grid solar energy through affordable financing models.
why: Multilateral development finance is vital to expanding clean power access across East Africa and driving private off-grid renewable energy investments.

impacts.name: Renewable Energy
impacts.why: World Bank endorsement supports international funding flows into national clean energy and electrification initiatives.
